objects.description: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) has used tools such as [NICECURL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1192) with command and control communication taking place over HTTPS.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling)
objects.description_fa: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) از ابزارهایی مانند [NICECURL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1192) استفاده کرده است که ارتباطات فرمان و کنترل از طریق HTTPS انجام می‌شود.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling)
